question: Do formula positions predict administrative roles across sites rather than merely within one archive?
minimum_data: Versioned SigLA/GORILA sign sequences, object types, find sites, damage flags
method: Leave-one-site-out template model with shuffled and frequency-matched baselines
success_condition: Predictions beat all preregistered baselines on multiple held-out sites and remain stable under plausible sign variants
failure_condition: Performance disappears on held-out sites or under transcription alternatives
main_risk: Site-specific copying conventions masquerade as grammar

question: Can proposed commodity or personnel sign classes predict ledger totals on unseen tablets?
minimum_data: CDLI images/transliterations, layout coordinates, numerical systems, tablet joins
method: Constraint model trained without the held-out tablets; independently recompute subtotals
success_condition: A fixed sign-class mapping predicts balanced unseen entries significantly better than permuted mappings
failure_condition: Mappings need tablet-specific exceptions or fail to predict arithmetic structure

question: Do cord hierarchy and non-numeric attributes predict accounting relationships between independently catalogued khipus?
minimum_data: Open Khipu records checked against museum objects, knot values, colors, attachment hierarchy, archive groups
method: Recompute decimal values and test archive-level links with entire groups held out
success_condition: A preregistered attribute model predicts sums or parent-child relationships in held-out archive groups
failure_condition: Only records used to design the mapping fit, or results vanish after correcting legacy fields
main_risk: Legacy catalog interpretations leak conclusions into features

question: Which reported textual regularities survive transcription and segmentation uncertainty?
minimum_data: Beinecke images, at least two independent diplomatic transcriptions, folio/line coordinates, scribal-hand labels
method: Run identical positional and repetition statistics over alternative transcription graphs and hand/section holdouts
success_condition: A regularity has the same direction and practical size across transcribers and unseen hands/sections
failure_condition: The effect depends on one alphabet, one transcriber, or arbitrary token boundaries

question: How much do duplicate impressions and sign-catalog choices inflate sequence evidence?
minimum_data: Object-level provenance, excavation IDs, image links, concordance crosswalk, damage and reading-direction uncertainty
method: Deduplicate at artifact level; rerun entropy and adjacency analyses over alternative sign merges/splits
success_condition: Core results persist across defensible catalogs and artifact-level bootstrap samples
failure_condition: Claimed syntax disappears after deduplication or plausible sign reconciliation

question: Are proposed script subsystems real or products of site, medium, and editor-specific sign splitting?
minimum_data: Edition crosswalk, object provenance, medium, site, sign variants, damage flags
method: Hierarchical clustering/classification with site and editor held out; compare against metadata-conditioned nulls
success_condition: Subsystem assignment generalizes beyond site/editor and is robust to ambiguous signs
failure_condition: Clusters track publisher, site, or medium rather than independent sign behavior

question: Which sign distinctions are visible on the objects rather than inherited from modern redrawings?
minimum_data: Calibrated high-resolution or 3-D images, surface coordinates, conservation metadata, blinded expert annotations
method: Measure inter-annotator agreement and image support for Barthel distinctions
success_condition: Experts independently recover distinctions from object imagery at prespecified agreement
failure_condition: Distinctions cannot be separated from wood grain, damage, or illustrator choices
main_risk: Limited physical access and surface degradation

question: Can independent transcribers agree on a stable sign inventory, direction, and boundaries?
minimum_data: Complete licensed images, page coordinates, codicological ordering, two blinded transcriptions
method: Adjudicated double transcription; compare direction and segmentation hypotheses without lexical assumptions
success_condition: High held-out agreement and a compact inventory explain new pages without ad hoc signs
failure_condition: Inventory grows continually or boundaries/direction remain annotator-dependent
main_risk: Single artifact and uncertain material history

question: How many incompatible sign-to-language mappings fit the complete sequence equally well?
minimum_data: Authoritative sign sequence and documented uncertainties
method: Simulation and minimum-description-length comparison with complexity penalties
success_condition: Demonstrate a broad equivalence class of fits, quantifying why translation is non-identifiable
failure_condition: One constrained model makes a genuinely unique externally anchored prediction
main_risk: Only 241 impressions and no independent text

question: Can a fixed morphological analysis predict forms and semantic classes in unseen inscriptions?
minimum_data: Versioned transliterations, text genre, find context, names/loans with external attestations
method: Artifact-level train/test split with a published lexicon and morphological parser
success_condition: Rules analyze unseen forms and correctly predict independently anchored names or contexts
failure_condition: Coverage relies on one-off glosses or rules change after seeing test texts
main_risk: Sparse bilingual anchors and formulaic genres
